p1: [low, ominous] You've heard the legend... someone secretly living in your attic. [whispers] In Los Angeles... it was true.
[low] Nineteen thirteen. A married woman named Dolly Oesterreich... hid a young man named Otto in her attic.
[low] By day, he crept down to clean. [whispers] At night, he wrote stories up there.
[low] When they moved to Los Angeles, Dolly made sure the new house had an attic.
[low, tense] August, nineteen twenty-two. [low, ominous] Gunshots.
[low] Her husband was found dead. Dolly was locked inside a closet.
[low] She said a burglar did it... and took his diamond watch.
[low, ominous] Otto locked her in, took the watch... and climbed back into the attic.
[low] When Dolly moved house, Otto moved with her. [whispers] Into the next attic.
[low] Eight years later, it all came out. The papers called him... the Bat Man.
[low] Convicted of manslaughter... he walked free. [low, ominous] The time limit had run out.
[whispers] Check your attic. [low] Follow for more true stories.
